How far the thumb may slide before the game sees movement.
The layout is the Xbox 360 one and the game is a GameCube game: LT becomes L, RT becomes R, LB and RB become Z. L3, R3 and BACK do not exist on the console controller and do nothing.
Above the screen it is supersampling: it smooths edges and costs GPU.
By default, the frame limit follows the display refresh rate. A lower limit can save battery.
Off leaves the frames free. On, presentation waits for the panel — and then the limit above does not matter, the panel decides.
Sharpness of textures seen edge-on, like the pitch.
What to do with the menu art on a screen wider than 4:3. Stretch fills the width; Keep proportions leaves it at the size it was drawn and carries its edge colour out to the sides.
Follow the screen uses the whole width of the phone. 4:3 is the GameCube\'s own shape, with bars at the sides — the original framing, and the one to compare against when something looks out of place.

Turnip is Mesa\'s open Vulkan driver for Adreno GPUs. On a device whose factory driver is old it usually goes faster; on a new device it usually changes nothing. Changing the driver does not affect the rest of the system — it applies to this app only.
The one the device maker installed.
The change takes effect the next time the game opens.
